Strategy: Aim for a post-placement residual of exactly one quarter of the item, leaving a small reserve that is larger than a sliver but smaller than a full item. It may help by keeping modest leftovers across bins, but may fail if quarter-item leftovers are too small to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - item - item / 4) for r in bins]
```
